hooks.name: on-exorcise-defect
hooks.description: After the agent edits the scanner or the healer, make sure the three sample programs still produce the documented pathologies and that healing leaves none.

action.command: in=$(cat); echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) on-exorcise-defect stdin=$(printf %s "$in" | tr -d "\n" | head -c 500)" >> benchmarks/hook-firings.log; case "$in" in *necro-core/src/scan.rs*|*necro-core/src/heal.rs*) cargo test --quiet --release -p necro-cobol-lifter --test lifter ;; esac; true
